```yaml
name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  build_and_test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        compiler: [gcc, clang]
        build_type: [Debug, Release]
    env:
      CXX: ${{ matrix.compiler }}
      BUILD_TYPE: ${{ matrix.build_type }}

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y \
            cmake \
            build-essential \
            libglog-dev \
            libgflags-dev \
            clang-tidy \
            cppcheck \
            clang-format

      - name: Cache CMake build
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: build
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-cmake-${{ matrix.compiler }}-${{ matrix.build_type }}-${{ hashFiles('**/CMakeLists.txt', '**/*.cmake') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-cmake-${{ matrix.compiler }}-${{ matrix.build_type }}-

      - name: Configure CMake
        run: |
          cmake -S . -B build \
            -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=${{ env.BUILD_TYPE }} \
            -DCMAKE_CXX_STANDARD=17 \
            -DCMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED=ON \
            -DCMAKE_CXX_EXTENSIONS=OFF \
            -DCMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS=ON

      - name: Build
        run: cmake --build build --config ${{ env.BUILD_TYPE }} -- -j$(nproc)

      - name: Run tests
        run: |
          cd build
          ctest --output-on-failure

      - name: Run clang-tidy
        if: matrix.compiler == 'clang'
        run: |
          clang-tidy -p build $(git ls-files '*.cpp' '*.c' '*.hpp' '*.h') --warnings-as-errors='*'

      - name: Run cppcheck
        run: |
          cppcheck --enable=all --inconclusive --std=c++17 --project=build/compile_commands.json

      - name: Check code formatting
        run: |
          clang-format --dry-run --Werror $(git ls-files '*.cpp' '*.c' '*.hpp' '*.h')
```
